submitted.rationale: EQE rises steadily with Sb content: 0.0008% at Sb 0.49, 0.014% at Sb 0.66 (the MgSb2O6 region), and 0.087% at Sb 0.81 (index 29, the most Sb-rich composition in the library). Sb-oxide-rich films are the most likely to absorb at 3.2 eV. MgO-rich compositions are wide-gap insulators and are not expected to be active.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE 0.014%, about 6 times lower than index 29
Not measured. Expected to be MgO or Mg-rich antimonate, both wide-gap, and the EQE trend falls with increasing Mg
